title: Unit 32 Consolidation: The Judiciary and the Rule of Law, 2011–2026
grammar: Review: obligation, nouns for procedures, concession, time frames and reported statements
goal: I can summarise the changes to the courts and the European procedures between 2011 and 2026, with years and sources.
I can state obligations in the past, name procedures, set a fact against an expectation, place events in a procedure and report statements.
I can date the change of government in 2026 and the later amendment of the Fundamental Law.
